description: This photo album features a leatherette cover with gold stamping. It initially holds 504 photos up to 4 x 6 inches, plus its 3-ring binding accepts refills (Style No. RST-6). Photos are displayed three per page in clear pockets with a white paper background. Archival, photo safe: acid, lignin and PVC free. Item measures approximately 2. 25 x 8. 5 x 13. 5 inches (L x W x H).
